name: manual_49a2ac
claim: Remote telemetry exporters must reuse the canonical connection-time pinned transport and disable environment proxies; preflight URL validation alone does not close DNS rebinding or proxy boundary shifts.

decisions.notes: PT observability closure tests showed that OTLP accepted unsafe endpoints and its requests session inherited proxy routing until configure_otel_exporter injected SSRFPinnedHTTPAdapter with trust_env disabled.
